Root-provenance verdict: TRUSTED PROVENANCE ROOT NOT ACHIEVABLE -- CURRENT TRUST MODEL INSUFFICIENT. Independently reproduced all four B-149O findings unchanged (tests/test_phase_149o_...py: 4 failed, 13 passed, identical to 149O's own reproduction). Stated the operative threat model explicitly (Threat A: same-process/no-separate-secret artifact construction, matching RAE-001 Sec.22 threat #2's own 'agent-generated fake approval JSON' entry -- not Threat B/full compromise, and not RAE-001 threat #3's already-disclosed forged-actor-identity gap). Independently inspected every plausible non-filesystem trust root in the codebase: PublicationCoordinator.authorize()/execute() (both pure shape validation over caller-supplied data, no secret step -- src/pcae/governance/publication/coordinator.py:91-211), session identity (generate_session_id, Session.owner_identity -- caller-supplied strings/UUIDs), the agent lock (.pcae/agent-lock.json -- agent_id taken verbatim from a CLI flag, no proof-of-possession -- src/pcae/core/agent.py:288-368), a repo-wide grep for signing/keychain/hardware/credential primitives (none found; every match is either a docstring disclaiming the capability or third-party-secret redaction logic), git history (unsigned commits already trusted for everything else in this repository), and Telegram (architecturally outbound-only -- no_telegram_inbound/telegram_inbound_allowed are frozen False invariants elsewhere in the codebase; repurposing it would require reversing multiple already-frozen no-inbound guarantees). Found no independently-trusted root anywhere: every artifact in the RAE chain is produced by code validating only shape/self-consistency of caller-supplied data, so the 149M->149N->149O receipt/registration sidecar cascade is provably circular (artifact does not prove receipt; receipt does not prove registration; registration does not prove artifact; no terminating, independent fact exists). Selected ROOT D (no viable root within current architecture) over ROOT A (none exists, per the inventory above), ROOT B (every same-process-reachable secret -- env var, plaintext file, keychain item without fresh per-use human-presence -- is equally readable by agent and human per RAE-REQ-009's own already-frozen admission that no privilege separation exists between them), and ROOT C (RAE-001 Sec.22 threat #2 is a genuine adversarial, technical claim citing RAE-REQ-018 as its control -- 149O's attacks directly falsified that specific claim, not scope creep past it). Because the governing phase prompt forbids implementing before a root is selected and forbids treating another sidecar as a fix, zero production code was changed this phase -- B-149O-1 through B-149O-4 remain OPEN, intentionally not patched. Mandatory threat-capability matrix and root-trust-proof statement recorded.
